title: Camp Wawona

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Qualified instructors and state of the art equipment are used to teach basic archery skills. For beginners we use a standard target range of 50 feet. Of course, you can feel comfortable knowing that Camp Wawona always puts an emphasis on range safety. Nothing beats painting masterpieces, forming ceramics, or tie dying fabrics to the sounds of nature and fun. Camp Wawona’s art activity offers instruction from inspiring young people who share a passion for creative expression and believe it a useful tool to enhance their sense of self. This activity is not just about cutting and pasting, it is about teaching young people to “see” the world in a new way. Everyone can create artwork, so choose
